name: siyasat
description: Siyasat: check that the references in a paper are real, correct and not retracted.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @siyasat/core build && concurrently -k -n core,api,web -c gray,magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter @siyasat/core dev" "pnpm --filter @siyasat/api dev" "pnpm --filter @siyasat/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @siyasat/core build && pnpm --filter @siyasat/api build && pnpm --filter @siyasat/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @siyasat/core build && pnpm --filter @siyasat/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @siyasat/web typecheck
